sql: select status, count(*) as n, count(*) filter (where created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-06 11:41:44.307194+00') as since_epoch, count(*) filter (where closed_at is not null and created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-06 11:41:44.307194+00') as settled_since_epoch from paper_trades where strategy='mmsell10' group by status order by n desc
